steps.note: Open the prepared live auction's buyer-side Responses screen while keeping the existing bid state.
Continue in the supplier portal as the invited vendor without losing the buyer session.
Open the live auction's pricing round where the existing 100 bid can be revised.
Enter and submit the revised bid of 90; the same vendor's second submission represents the revision.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the revision and shows the round as submitted.
Return to the buyer's session to inspect the updated bid.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid for the live auction.
Verify Master QCS uses the revised price of 90.
Verify the live ranking reflects the current auction price.
